title: The Art of Scaling Test-Time Compute for Large Language Models
authors_zh: Aradhye Agarwal（微软研究院）；Ayan Sengupta、Tanmoy Chakraborty（印度理工学院德里分校）
paper_type_zh: 大规模测试时扩展比较研究
best_for_zh: 需要为异质推理模型选择推理策略的读者。
one_line: This study maps when shortest-trace voting, beam search, or majority voting is the best use of test-time compute.
该研究说明最短轨迹投票、束搜索和多数投票各自适用的模型类型、题目难度与测试时预算不同。
why: It argues that no universal test-time strategy exists; the right policy depends on model horizon and compute budget.
inclusion_reason: It compares how model horizon, problem difficulty, and budget determine the best test-time scaling strategy.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Published comparisons often recommend one test-time strategy from a narrow model family. Yet newer reasoning models differ in whether long traces remain coherent, and one strategy can waste compute or degrade answers on the wrong model.

The paper asks how strategy choice should depend jointly on a model, task difficulty, and available budget. It seeks a practical rule rather than assuming that longer thought or more samples always help.

已有比较常从狭窄模型族中推荐一种测试时策略。但较新的推理模型在长轨迹能否保持连贯上存在差异，错误策略可能浪费计算或降低答案质量。

论文研究策略选择应如何同时依赖模型、题目难度和可用预算。它寻求实际规则，而不是假定更长思考或更多样本总是有益。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The authors classify models by reasoning horizon. Short-horizon models benefit from concise traces, whereas long-horizon models can profit from deeper deliberation on hard prompts.

Strategy is therefore selected by budget: shortest traces at low budget, beam search at intermediate budget, and majority voting at high budget for the appropriate model family.

作者按推理视界分类模型。短视界模型受益于简洁轨迹，而长视界模型能在困难提示上从更深思考获益。

因此策略由预算选择：适当模型族在低预算用最短轨迹，中预算用束搜索，高预算用多数投票。

title: Method
方法
html:
The study generates more than thirty billion tokens from eight open models between 7B and 235B on four reasoning datasets. It compares first-finish search, last-finish search, majority voting, and beam search.

Models are grouped by trace-quality behavior over length and difficulty, then strategies are evaluated at matched parallel-trace budgets.

研究在四个推理数据集上，从 7B 到 235B 的八个开放模型生成超过三百亿词元。它比较首完成搜索、末完成搜索、多数投票和束搜索。

模型按长度和难度下的轨迹质量行为分组，再在匹配的并行轨迹预算下评估策略。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper finds no universal winner. Short-horizon models favor concise traces, while long-horizon models can maintain gains from longer reasoning; optimal performance for a fixed model type rises monotonically with budget.

The reported figure uses AIME 2024–2025 and GPQA Diamond to show shortest traces, beam search, and majority vote occupying different compute regions.

论文发现不存在通用赢家。短视界模型偏好简洁轨迹，而长视界模型能保持较长推理带来的增益；固定模型类型的最优性能随预算单调上升。

文中用 AIME 2024–2025 和 GPQA Diamond 显示最短轨迹、束搜索和多数投票各占不同计算区间。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The contribution is a model-aware strategy map rather than another search algorithm. It connects post-training behavior to a reasoning horizon that determines whether extra trace length is useful.

This framing explains why conflicting test-time results can both be correct: strategy quality is conditional on model family, difficulty, and budget.

贡献是面向模型的策略地图，而不是另一种搜索算法。它把后训练行为联系到推理视界，后者决定额外轨迹长度是否有用。

这一表述解释了为何相互冲突的测试时结果都可能正确：策略质量取决于模型族、难度和预算。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The model-horizon categories are empirical and may change after post-training or under new task distributions. The API-oriented study also restricts the search procedures it can implement, so it does not settle the value of every verifier or tool-using method.
模型视界类别来自实证，可能随再训练或新任务分布改变。面向 API 的研究也限制了可实现的搜索程序，因此不能判定每种验证器或工具使用方法的价值。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use the paper when selecting an existing inference policy for a model fleet. Profile trace quality by difficulty before applying a one-size-fits-all sampling budget, and use the released code as a starting point for a matched comparison.
当需要为模型集群选择既有推理策略时，可使用该论文。在采用统一采样预算前，应按难度分析轨迹质量，并以发布代码为匹配比较的起点。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the model taxonomy before the strategy recommendation. The paper’s durable result is conditional strategy selection, not a claim that a particular search is best in every deployment.
应先阅读模型分类，再阅读策略建议。论文持久的结果是条件化策略选择，而不是声称某一种搜索在每次部署中都最好。
